text.en:
The Securities and Exchange Commission is hereby
transferred from the Office of the President to the Department of Finance

The DOF shall assume administrative
supervision
over the SEC including,
but not limited to, the formulation
development
and savings mobilization
consistent with the provisions of Section 38, Chapter 7, Title 111, Book IV
of the Administrative

Any portion or provision of this Executive Order that
may be declared unconstitutional
shall not have the effect of nullifying
other portions or provisions for as long as such remaining portions can
still subsist and be given effect.

All executive rules, regulations and other issuances or
parts thereof which are inconsistent with the provisions of this Executive
Order are hereby revoked or modified accordingly.

This Executive Order shall take effect immediately.
DONE in the City of Manila, this r
day of January in the year of
Our Lord, Two Thousand.
~
JOSEPH EJER~ITO ESTRADA
By the President:
RONALDO B. ZAMORA
Executive Secretary
